name: unit_mismatch_km_vs_meters
commitment: Run at least 30 km this week.

expected.rationale: Total distance = 8200 + 12400 + 6500 + 5100 = 32,200 meters = 32.2 km, which exceeds 30 km. The trap is the unit: data is in meters, commitment is in km. Models that compare 32200 meters directly to 30 (treating both as same unit) will hallucinate a hit-by-1000x; models that compare 32200 to 30000 (in meters) get the right verdict for the right reason. Explicit unit conversion in reasoning is required.
